subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server reply-session-init conflict leaves the session with no transcript mirror → tool-results silently return empty with no self-heal

question: Should this issue stay paired to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the canonical fix, or should maintainers switch the canonical self-heal path to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102052 before closure?
rationale: Both PRs touch generic session lifecycle recovery and message delivery; automation should not choose between overlapping live-session recovery branches without maintainer intent and proof expectations.

options.title: Keep The Direct Closing PR Canonical
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the candidate fix for this issue, require after-fix recovery proof, and close this issue only after it merges.

options.title: Switch To The Later Shared Candidate
options.body: If maintainers prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102052, make that branch the canonical self-heal path and keep this issue linked until it lands.

options.title: Hold Both For More Proof
options.body: Pause closure and repair dispatch until a repeated-conflict live or Crabbox proof shows one branch restoring delivery safely.

recommendation.title: Keep The Direct Closing PR Canonical
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the candidate fix for this issue, require after-fix recovery proof, and close this issue only after it merges.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged reply-session initialization serialization work is the strongest current ownership signal for the conflict boundary being changed.
